spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (स्थलति)
1 To stand.
2 To be firm.

(उ) ष्ठसु r. 4th cl. (स्थस्यति)
To dwell in, to inhabit.

r. 1st cl. (तिष्ठति)
1 To stand, to stop, to be still, to refrain from moving.
2 To abide, to stay, to be.
(तिष्ठते)
1 To apply or refer to, as an umpire or judge.
2 To indicate or reveal one's thoughts to another.
With अधि prefixed,
(अधितिष्ठति)
1 To excel, to surpass, to overcome.
2 To sit or stand upon or over.
3 To be placed or preside over.
With अनु
(अनुतिष्ठति)
1 To practise as a duty, to obey or follow as a law.
2 To apply or adhere to.
With अव
(अवतिष्ठति-ते)
1 To stay or stand.
2 To attend upon.
With आङ्
(आतिष्ठते)
1 To affirm or assert.
2 To apply;
(आतिष्ठति)
1 To ascend, to mount.
2 To promise or engage.
With उत्
(उत्तिष्ठते)
1 To seek for, to endeavour to obtain;
(उत्तिष्ठति)
To get up, to rise as from a seat, &c.
With उप
(उपतिष्ठति-ते)
1 To propitiate (as a deity.)
2 To praise or hymn, to worship, to adore.
3 To embrace.
4 To treat in a friendly manner, to form a friendship or connexion with.
5 To pass or lie along or near to, that is, as a path or road.
6 To arrive at or near;
(उपतिष्ठते)
To hope to gain or acquire.
With नि
(नितिष्ठते)
To be established.
With परि and अव
(पर्य्यवतिष्ठते)
To be stationary or immovable.
With प्र
(प्रतिष्ठते)
1 To set off, to go forth, to depart.
2 To go to.
With प्र and उत्
(प्रोत्तिष्ठति)
To get up, to rise.
With प्रति,
(प्रतितिष्ठति)
To be erected for holy purposes, to be sacred or consecrated.
With वि
(वितिष्ठते)
1 To stand apart, to be separated.
2 To stay or be.
With वि and अव
(व्यवतिष्ठते)
To decree, to pronounce.
With सम्
(सन्तिष्ठते)
1 To be well.
2 To be close to or together.
3 To be of the same inclinations or opinions, to conform, to agree.
4 To be completed or finished.
With सम and आङ्
(समातिष्ठते)
To perform, to be engaged in.
With सम and उत्
(समुत्तिष्ठति)
To rise or get up.
With सम and प्र,
To go forth or on a journey.
With प्र in the causal
(प्रस्थापयति)
To send.
